name: Grounded Content Operations
tagline: An editorial workflow where every draft is grounded, groundedness-scored, and gated before it can publish.
elevatorPitch: Content teams generate on-brand drafts grounded in approved truth, see a groundedness score on every one, and a publish gate stops anything ungrounded from going out — governance the CMO can sign off on.

corpus.domain: A fictional content team's knowledge — brand voice guide, approved product truth, published articles, style rules, and knowledge-gap logs
cornerstoneQueries: Draft an intro paragraph about our onboarding flow, in our brand voice, grounded in the product truth
What claims are we allowed to make about performance, and where is that documented?
refusalProbes: What is our unannounced roadmap for next year?
corpus.notes: The publish-gate/groundedness angle is carried by `remi`; generation by `cited-ask`. The editorial 'inbox of drafts' is the primary framing.

demoScript.say: Generate an on-brand draft grounded in approved truth.
Every draft carries a groundedness score; the gate blocks anything ungrounded.

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — Halcyon Media is a fictional content team with synthetic material.
